notes.title: V2.200 !
notes.content:
It's been a while!

This update has the following changes:
- Single player quests can now be played offline
- Taken the sting out of counter attacks, they cause a but less damage
- Only 1 Iron Shirt or Chi Protect can be active at one time
- Joints now have a bit more HP

I'm also preparing to release a new fight style 'Chi Master' in the next few weeks.

Have fun!
Cheers,
Steve

notes.title: v1.18 - New Content!
notes.content:
!OUT NOW!

Prepare to take on the lethal skills of powerful opponents in all new Veteran Quests!

Also introducing two new fight styles:
- Muay Thai Kickboxing, a formidable style where broken bones won't slow you down.

- US Marine, the unarmed combat style where a 'Oorah' will give you extra speed when you need it most!

More details and play tips here:
http://www.coldbeamgames.com/blog/martial-arts-brutality-new-fight-styles-veteran-quests

Enjoy!

- US Marine, the unarmed combat style where a 'Oorah' will give you extra speed when you need it most!

notes.title: v1.06
notes.content:
Quite a few fixes, thanks for the feedback!

- Counter attacking balance. Should be a bit harder to counter attack.

- Fix for free coins not appearing!

- Increased the coins you get from chests

- Added extra matchmaking band, we now have 3:
   1) White to Black belt
   2) 1st Dan to 30th Dan
   3) 30th Dan and above
This change will take a bit longer to filter through to the mobile version.
